Martin Varghese

Human. Dreamer. Builder.

Hey,

I'm Martin. A Human. A Dreamer. A Builder.

I co-founded Oronium and I'm currently building StoreShield AI.

I like building things for the real world. I like problems that don't come with a neat instruction manual.

Mostly, I'm curious.

Curious about how things work, why people do what they do, why businesses behave the way they do, why technology changes everything and, occasionally, why I thought starting another company was a good idea.

That curiosity gave me the courage to follow my heart and build things.

I talk about AI, business, people, life, and sometimes philosophy — usually without knowing enough about any of them.

I love life.

I love people.

I love listening.

I love talking.

And I have far too many thoughts.

Some are useful.

Some are stupid.

Most are somewhere in between.

You can find some of them below.

A great guy once told the world to stay foolish.

I'm trying.

One thing I believe

What is the meaning of life?

Just live.

Nothing more.

Nothing less.

Seems almost too simple.

Which is probably why we spend so much time making it complicated.
